subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Group guided: reads with increasing fluency and expression; monitors self

show.line: Read like you talk! The frog can hop. Smooth, not one word at a time. Let's read!

rounds.prompt: Read this sentence to me. Make it smooth.
rounds.text: The frog sat on a log.
accept: the frog sat on a log
the frog sat on a log.
the frog sat on the log

rounds.prompt: Which picture matches? The ship is big.
Does this make sense? The dog chops the grass. Tap the word that is wrong.
rounds.praise: Yes! A dog does not chop. Check it makes sense.

rounds.text: Chin up, said the thin man.
accept: chin up said the thin man
chin up said the thin man.
chin up the thin man said

rounds.story: Thandi sees a crab on the sand. It is red. She claps. What did Thandi see?

hints: Read it once slowly. Then again, smoothly.
Stop and check. Does it make sense?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this sentence.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The. Frog. Sat. On. The. Log.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I read like a robot. The frog sat on a log.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together, smoothly. The frog sat on a log!

parent_line: Can read short sentences smoothly and check that they make sense.
